name: Eyes In The Night does not redirect threat when the protected ally is higher-health (#3247)
contract: reversed: the ally is fixtured at 100% health and the Bloodmage at 10%, so aura_ascension_bloodmage_
shadow_colony's AfterEffectProc health-percent guard (AscensionBloodmageSecondary.cpp) must never move
threat, however many times Shadow Colony 806723 procs. This assertion does not depend on the proc chance
at all (no transfer is correct whether or not a proc happens), but the scenario still drives 90 s of
continuous aggressive melee from the fixture biter to exercise the actual proc path at least once rather
than trivially pass from an untested mechanism.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Bloodmage at 10% health, below the ally
Ally at 100% health, well above the Bloodmage
Bloodmage applies Shadow Colony to the grouped, nearby ally (infinite duration)
SETUP: the biter has no threat on the Bloodmage yet
The ally engages; the aggressive biter fights back, repeatedly rolling Shadow Colony's taken-damage proc
Let roughly 45 independent proc rolls happen
SETUP: Shadow Colony proc'd at least once
DISCRIMINATING: the biter never gained threat against the Bloodmage (the ally is not lower-health)
